title: 東京大賞典の後に・地方の“テッペン”

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Inari One is picking up the pace! She's pulling away! And Inari One takes it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: You were amazing, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Inariii! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Heh… You've become a fine racer indeed.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Look at me… I can't even hold back a few tears.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This heat…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's making my heart race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I agree… That's how breathtaking this race was. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I did it…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I did it… I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: YEAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I won! I'm standin' at the top of the regionals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss! Did ya see that?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Boss! Did ya see that?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: We did it! Right here in Oi… the top belongs to us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari! Inari! Inari! Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank ya so much! I, Inari One, wanna take this opportunity to make an announcement!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: In my senior year… I'm gonna take the top of the centrals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I plan on winnin' a bunch of G1 races! And then…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll become next year's Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ I just knew Inari had something big in store.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: She knows that we're here. This must be…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is a message to us as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …I won't lose to you, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: That was a surprise. Today's race was one thing, but I didn't think those two thought so highly of Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: And to top it off, the whole crowd's buzzing with energy after her declaration!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: I thought Tamamo Cross's absence would put things at a standstill, but this might change things up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss. What race should I go for next?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Boss. What race should I go for next?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm stunned that she'd turn to ask me that so soon after her win, but I know just the race to start her senior year!
choice_data_list: Let's do the spring Tenno Sho!
Let's do the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sounds good to me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'm takin' on the spring Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Get ready, 'cause I'm gonna launch one huge firework after another in the wildest festival anyone's ever seen in the centrals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So don't forget to come—you won't wanna miss it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, I've said it in front of everyone. No backin' down now, partner!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hah! That's my trainer—cool as ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with Inari One's domination of the regionals behind us…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our fiery procession continues as we make our way to the next festival—the G1 central races of her senior year!
